scope: Post-result mechanism diagnostic of six fixed structure families; not a new statistical contrast or candidate selection.
authorship: Model implementer and v4 adapter author; not external blind review.

input_manifest.target: official TJEA daily total transaction published two-decimal mean, CNY/tonne; not close
input_manifest.source_processing: all1077 official daily-total records retained and sorted; no interpolation, deletion, monthly outlier replacement or recomputation from turnover/volume
input_manifest.source_vintage: current public historical snapshot; per-day publication vintages unverified

sources.source: first TJEA table, daily-total published rounded mean and total tonnes
sources.license: no redistribution license established; raw and prepared source remain private

volume.normalization: current log1p total tonnes minus prior60record median, divided by prior std floored.25, clipped[-5,5]; >=10 past observations
volume.information: current official price and total volume known after origin report; turnover not an input
volume.raw_information_span: 64 feature tokens plus up to60 earlier records for volume references

input_manifest.role: fixed later-period replication on one official market; not a cross-market macro

aggregation: Single official Tianjin tail, equal H1/H5/H20 mean of individual-seed MSE/RW; no cross-market macro.
initialization_interpretation: All three seeds have identical initial prediction functions; v1 MLP hidden weights remain seed-specific, so numerical state comparisons use the same seed.
numeric_state_hash_definition: SHA256 of sorted tensor names/dtypes/shapes JSON headers and contiguous CPU numpy bytes; distinct from serialized pt byte SHA.

initial_parameters.gate: MLP hidden16; final layer zero, seed-specific hidden weights
